_doc: Enforcement-parity ledger (ADR-033). Every audit finding must exit via one of: test | ci | guard | waiver. exit.type='open' entries age against severity SLAs (high=30d, medium=60d, low=90d from 'filed'). scripts/ledger_check.py fails CI on delinquent entries. Waivers require 'expires' and 'reason'; an expired waiver is delinquent. Do NOT close a finding by deleting it — set its exit and keep the row.

findings.summary: Unauthenticated POST /api/compass calls the Anthropic API with no rate limit — wallet-drain/abuse vector.

exit.ref: src/lib/ratelimit.ts wired into src/app/api/compass/route.ts (interim in-memory limiter)

findings.summary: Durable, cross-instance rate limiting + spend caps + LLM observability via Vercel AI Gateway (replaces RL-001 interim limiter; also covers /api/brief and /api/guide Claude calls).
Trust contract §3 promises account deletion within 30 days but no implemented deletion path existed.
Trust contract §1 (anonymous sessions write nothing server-side) has no regression test — the exact defect disclosed in §1 could silently recur.
src/lib/ygate.ts (core scoring algorithm, pure function) has zero unit tests.
CI lint is advisory (continue-on-error); no lint rule prevents className/Tailwind recurrence after the 2026-07-11 removal.
No exception tracking on the app (SageTrace exposure was detected via a vendor email, not our own alerting).
DATABASE_URL manually set, rotation risk open since ADR-005 amendment (2026-05-28).

exit.reason: Requires Zach to rotate the Supabase password and re-sync Vercel envs — not executable by a session alone.

findings.summary: Production DB backup restore has never been tested — an unrestored backup is a hope, not a backup.
Trust contract §2 'aggregate anonymized only' modeling claim has no code boundary enforcing it (purpose limitation is prose-only).
Orphaned Supabase tables (meeting_cards/risks/raci/etc.) with no owning app; 4 advisor WARNs deliberately unfixed (backlog #13/#14).
